text: On April 6, 2021, a Zoning By-law Amendment application was submitted to permit the redevelopment of 54 - 62 Glen Everest Road (the "Site") with a 12-storey residential building with 427 units including 68 replacement rental units. A separate application for rental housing demolition was also submitted to permit the demolition of 68 rental units located on the Site. A revised proposal was submitted on June 28, 2022 increasing the gross floor area to 32,901 square metres and reducing the total number of residential units to 414 units. The Applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its application for the Zoning By-law Amendment (the "Appeal"), to the Ontario Land Tribunal on July 13, 2022.
